packages.known_issue: Starts and draws its no-file menu, but WordStar is an 80-column program: the layout does not fit the 51-column screen, so the display wraps and is unreadable. Needs an 80-column screen mode (3px font).
packages.notes: Full-screen editor; exercises terminal escape handling and overlays.

packages.notes: Compiler/IDE with overlays; exercises TPA and console handling. The 80-column IDE layout is wider than the 51-column screen, so the display wraps.
